files.description: CEO Assam, General Election to Assam Legislative Assembly 2021: 'Total Polling Station and General Electors - PHASE wise' (5 pages; columns S.No, Name of Revenue District, Name of the Election District, AC No & Name, Total PS, General Electors). Linked as 'Total numbers of Polling Station and Elector details in Phase wise' from https://ceoassam.nic.in/assembly/2021/assembly-election-2021.html. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for the 126 pre-2023 (1976-order) ACs.
CEO Assam AE-2021 page (provenance of the PDF above; links are in its inline JS 'sections' array).

OCR text (Internet Archive, tesseract) of 'The Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 1976' as printed by the Election Commission of India (uploaded 2024-05-11; item description says it was retrieved from the ECI's 'Archive Delimitation Orders' page). The governing order for these four states: Assam = Schedule IV, Bihar (incl. the 81 Jharkhand ACs, Bihar Nos. 147-164 and 262-324) = Schedule V, Manipur = Schedule XIV, Nagaland = Schedule XVI. Source of ac_name, the 1976 district headings and every AC's extent (used to document cross-district territory).
Internet Archive metadata of the item above (creator, provenance, file list with checksums).

CEO Jharkhand 'AC & PC LIST - JHARKHAND' (Details of AC): division / No. & Name of District / No. & Name of ACs / parts, plus a PC-wise half. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for Jharkhand's 81 ACs (24 districts = the 24 Census-2011 districts).

CEO Manipur 'Who's Who of Election Officials': table of Electoral Registration Officers with columns District | AC Name ('N - Name') | ERO | Designation | Email. PRIMARY source of district_2008 for Manipur's 60 ACs (unchanged since the 1976 order).
CEO Nagaland 'Assembly Constituencies and Polling Stations' page listing one PDF per election district (16 files).
